name: quick-ai
description: Quick.ai - AI content creation SaaS (Express + React)

scripts.install-all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev:server: node init && npm --prefix server run dev
scripts.dev:client: node init && npm --prefix client run dev
scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: node init && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.start: node init && npm --prefix server run start
